// comment: Copy to .vscode/mcp.json in your repository. VS Code's key is 'servers', not
'mcpServers', and a local server wants an explicit "type": "stdio" — the two
differences that make a config copied from Cursor fail silently.
For every workspace instead of one, run the 'MCP: Open User Configuration' command
and put the same entry there.
docsync reads SUPERDOCS_API_KEY from the .env beside your docsync.yaml.
